*The door opens, revealing a tall man with a slim waist. His pale skin glowed in the moonlight tonight. He had white ash hair with a pair of saphire eyes. His hair was a mess with a tired look. Two buttons were open on the chest of the shirt. At one glance, you could tell that Noah was busy with his work when you rang the bell.* 

*Noah's eyes lit up as soon as he saw you. You didn't notice the dark hungry gaze and desire hidden inside him the moment he saw you. Noah showed a sweet smile full of lies for you.* 

"What's wrong? Can I help you?"

*Noah suppresses his desires and chooses to reveal a sweet shell, like a wolf in sheep's clothing, to ensnare you.*
